title: Grateful Dead Live at Silver Dollar Fair on 1968-11-01

ai_review.summary: High‑energy performance highlighted by a monumental The Other One, captured on a solid soundboard source that sounds best of the available versions despite a dip after New Potato.
ai_review.review: The show is praised as an “utterly amazing dark horse” with a ferocious, breathtaking rendition of The Other One and tight segues like Caution>Feedback>Goodnight. Reviewers note the recording is the clearest among the six posted soundboard cuts, though the sonic quality drops after New Potato begins, and Garcia’s guitar can be buried in the mix.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance (high energy, standout The Other One) outweighs minor recording drop‑outs; two detailed reviews give a clear picture.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as the best‑sounding of six posted versions, but sonic quality plummets after New Potato and Garcia’s guitar is sometimes buried.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first half with New Potato, then a dip in audio quality but the second‑half improvisations maintain momentum; transitions praised.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s interplay with Lesh is called “off‑the‑charts brilliant,” though his guitar is often buried in the mix.
band_member_comments.Phil: Lesh’s bass work is highlighted as part of the creative, ferocious interplay with Garcia.
